deal_value.notes: All-cash ~$40M for 100%, subject to purchase price adjustments; consideration increased by cash left in the business (minimum $5M), making effective consideration ~$45M per MarketScreener; $4M indemnity escrow and $0.6M adjustment escrow; completed January 11, 2021

calculable.implied_multiple: ~0.9x Price / FY2019 revenue (roughly 0.6-0.7x on 2020 revenue of over $60M YTD)
calculable.calculation: $40M headline consideration / $45.1M FY2019 revenue = 0.89x; on 2020 YTD revenue of >$60M (through ~Oct 2020): $40M / $60M = <0.67x; also ~15.4x FY2019 net income ($40M / $2.6M)
inputs: Purchase price ~$40M all-cash plus cash-left-in-business adjustment (>=$5M) - Ideanomics definitive agreement press release, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ideanomics-announces-definitive-agreement-to-acquire-timios-holdings-corp-301171853.html and Seeking Alpha, https://seekingalpha.com/news/3635454-ideanomics-to-acquire-timios-holdings-for-40m

Timios FY2019 revenue $45.1M, operating income $4.5M, net income $2.6M - deal disclosures reported via MarketScreener, https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/IDEANOMICS-INC-47133993/news/Ideanomics-Inc-completed-the-acquisition-of-Timios-Inc-from-a-group-of-shareholders-33564470/

Timios 2020 YTD revenue over $60M including over $8M in October 2020 - Ideanomics press releases, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ideanomics-completes-the-acquisition-of-timios-holdings-corp-301205156.html
calculable.caveats: Headline price adjusted upward by cash retained in the business (effective ~$45M, but offset by acquired cash so ~$40M is a reasonable EV proxy); FY2019 revenue predates the deal by a year while the fuller 2020 figure is only a soft 'over $60M YTD'; no full-year 2020 Timios revenue was firmly published at announcement

notes: Hint date adjusted: the definitive agreement was announced November 2020; January 11, 2021 was the completion date. No multiple was published. Multiple computed on the $40M headline against firm FY2019 revenue of $45.1M; the 2020-based multiple is softer since only 'over $60M YTD' was disclosed.
